requirement: These scenes carry no text. An artboard that embeds one must print, next to it, every caption listed in that scene's mustPrint. Until it does, the scene is not shippable.
key: Roster-ready / Registered · not calibrated / Not available — from population.py
provenance: Natural Earth 1:50m admin-0 (public domain) via world-atlas 2.0.2 (ISC); ISO 3166-1 codes via i18n-iso-countries 7.14.0 (MIT)
disclaimer: Boundaries are Natural Earth de facto lines, drawn for orientation. They are not a political statement.
stars: Agent-stars show the shape of the place, not where people live or the panel size. Illustrative.
north: The large north star above a map or on the pole is the frame's north; the small filled north star on a country is the roster-ready mark.

scenes.title: ns-world
scenes.caption: The world in agent-stars, Equal Earth. Small countries the lattice misses carry one dot-mode agent; micro territories carry one locator dot each, except where a dot would sit within 2.2 px of another agent (9 features: n-cyprus, VC, VG, MS, GG, MO, SX, BL, MF).

scenes.title: ns-world-focus
scenes.caption: Into Finland (roster-ready). The Finland map is its own Lambert azimuthal equal-area framing and includes Åland. The map shows the frame, not composition: margins are drawn only on the Population card.

scenes.title: ns-world-focus-jp
scenes.caption: Into Japan (roster-ready). Own LAEA framing; the Ryukyu Islands (Amami to Yaeyama) and Ogasawara (Hahajima) are drawn in insets at the map's scale, displaced from their true position; the Ōsumi Islands are at true position. All 34 Natural Earth parts are drawn.

scenes.title: ns-earth
scenes.caption: Land-only agent-stars on an orthographic globe, one turn per loop; depth by size and opacity. No coastlines or borders are drawn on the globe, and no market status.
